translation: As for cutting open the intestines and washing the stomach, let us not speak of it; their formulas were not transmitted. Even if Hua Yuanhua's formulas had been transmitted to the present, it would still be hard to imitate his making of formulas. Only when Master Zhongjing appeared was there the 《Zubing Lun》 (Treatise on Sudden Disease) to treat cold damage, writing 113 formulas, and the 《Jingui Yaolue》 (Essential Prescriptions of the Golden Coffer) to treat miscellaneous diseases, writing 112 medical formulas; truly he opened the way first, being the ancestor. He also obtained Wang Shuhe to interpret and arrange them, making Zhongjing's subtle purport even more manifest. Shuhe did not create new formulas, but simply narrated Zhongjing's formulas to make formulas.
